# AI · agents & building with AI

### Agent loop
- What: An AI that plans, acts, checks the result, and repeats until the job is done.
- Applies when: the term comes up.
- Stage: any
- Kind: concept

### MCP
- What: A standard way to connect AI assistants to tools and data sources.
- Applies when: the term comes up.
- Stage: any
- Kind: concept

### Autonomy guardrails
- What: Limits on what an AI agent may do without asking, and how many steps it may take.
- Applies when: an AI model in the app can take actions that change things.
- Stage: day-one-if
- Kind: checkable
- Proof: test
- Done when: Actions that change or delete things need the user's approval, and each run has a cap on its number of steps.

### Context engineering
- What: Choose carefully what the AI sees, so it has what it needs and nothing that distracts it.
- Applies when: the term comes up.
- Stage: any
- Kind: concept

### AI code review
- What: Have an AI review each change for bugs before it is kept.
- Applies when: every app.
- Stage: day-one
- Kind: practice

### Verify with AI
- What: Have the AI run and test what it built, instead of trusting that it works.
- Applies when: every app.
- Stage: day-one
- Kind: practice

### Live prompts
- What: Change the app's prompts without releasing new code.
- Applies when: prompts need tuning while the app is live.
- Stage: with-users
- Kind: checkable

### Prompt versioning
- What: Keep a history of prompt changes, so a bad change can be undone.
- Applies when: prompts change while the app is live.
- Stage: with-users
- Kind: checkable

### Safe templates
- What: Let users edit templates that only fill in blanks and can never run code.
- Applies when: users can edit templates the app fills in.
- Stage: with-users
- Kind: checkable
